cameraPanel.dragTheBlockOn: Drag the block on the camera track to move it; drag its ends to change when it starts and stops.

cameraPanel.useTheCameraS: Use the camera''s default corner (Camera section) in this change

layoutTrack.doubleClickToChange: Double-click to change the camera layout here
layoutTrack.theCameraIsHidden: The camera is hidden: layouts apply once it is shown (Camera panel)

layoutCommands.noCorner: The camera layout here has no camera corner: pick the default, large camera or side by side layout first

director.part.bubbleCorner: Bubble {corner, select, top-left {top left} top-right {top right} bottom-left {bottom left} bottom-right {bottom right} other {corner}}
director.reason.cursor: your cursor works in the {corner, select, top-left {top left} top-right {top right} bottom-left {bottom left} bottom-right {bottom right} other {corner}}
director.facePlanned: Face centred · measured when you direct
director.summary: {count, plural, =1 {{n} change · camera on screen {percent}% of the video} other {{n} changes · camera on screen {percent}% of the video}}
director.keptChanges: {count, plural, =1 {Keeps {n} layout change of yours} other {Keeps {n} layout changes of yours}}
director.keptPositions: {count, plural, =1 {Keeps {n} camera position of yours} other {Keeps {n} camera positions of yours}}
director.keptBoth: Keeps {count, plural, =1 {{n} layout change} other {{n} layout changes}} and {positions, plural, =1 {{p} camera position} other {{p} camera positions}} of yours
director.source.mix: Listening to the recording's sound (no separate microphone): sounds from your PC count as talking.
director.source.mixVoice: Listening for voices in the recording's sound (no separate microphone): voices from your PC count as talking.
director.source.mixRefined: Listening to the recording's sound, checked against your captions.
director.soundFailedCaptions: The sound could not be measured: the plan uses your captions' word timings.
director.soundFailedInput: The sound could not be measured: the plan uses the mouse and keyboard only.
director.note.cameraHidden: The camera is hidden: show it to direct it.
director.note.noSound: No microphone was recorded, so there is no intro, outro or hiding: the director keeps the bubble clear of your cursor and centres your face.
director.note.noSpeech: No talking was heard, so the camera stays on throughout and there is no intro or outro.
director.note.noInput: This recording has no mouse or keyboard data: the director hides the camera in silences and frames your face, but cannot keep the bubble clear of the cursor.
director.note.noDemo: Nothing happens on screen that the director can see (no clicks, scrolling, typing or zooms), so it cannot tell the intro from the demo.
director.note.allYours: Your own camera changes cover the whole video: nothing left to direct.
director.note.optionsOff: The intro and outro, hiding and bubble moves are all off, so the director adds nothing to the camera track.
director.note.nothing: Nothing to change: no talking before or after the demo, no long silences, and the cursor never came near the camera.
director.note.band: The camera is in a band while the view follows the action, so it is not moved between corners.
director.nothing.i: Nothing to change: no talking before or after the demo.
director.nothing.s: Nothing to change: no long silences.
director.nothing.c: Nothing to change: the cursor never came near the camera.
director.nothing.is: Nothing to change: no talking before or after the demo and no long silences.
director.nothing.ic: Nothing to change: no talking before or after the demo and the cursor never came near the camera.
director.nothing.sc: Nothing to change: no long silences and the cursor never came near the camera.
director.lead: One click builds your camera track: the full camera while you talk before and after the demo, the bubble kept clear of your cursor, hidden in long silences, and your face centred. Changes you made yourself are kept.
director.ownershipHint: Changing a block made by the director makes it yours: Direct again keeps it. Direct again brings back automatic changes you deleted; turn off what made them above.
director.keptPositionsHint: You placed the camera yourself (while recording or with Move camera here): those positions are kept either way.
director.userFramingHint: You framed the camera yourself; turn this on to let the director frame it.
director.autoLayoutHint: Made by the auto director. Changing it makes it yours; Direct again keeps it.
director.autoTitleSuffix: · automatic: change it to keep it when you direct again
director.framedMoving: You move around a lot, so the camera is centred on you with little zoom.
director.notFound: No one was found in the camera picture, so the framing was left as it was.
director.framingUnavailable: Face framing is unavailable: {reason}. The rest of the camera track was directed.
director.framingKept: Your framing is kept (turn on Centre my face to let the director frame you).
director.done.moves: {count, plural, =1 {{n} bubble move} other {{n} bubble moves}}
